comment: M59: the upgrade reference worlds of this branch are built, not stored. smoketestUpgrade (and runServer -PsmoketestOldWorld) build a missing one in the saves folder of the run with tools/upgrade/<script> from the commit named here (build_reference.sh: that commit's buildShowcase plus DevUpgradeReference). 'default' is the world smoketestUpgrade loads without -PupgradeWorld; the reference of this branch was made with its first version 1.42.0-beta.1.
